get_model_type: get the transformers model type from a HuggingFace or PEFT config object
extract_dtype: extract the torch dtype from a HuggingFace pretrained config object
set_config_dtype: set the torch dtype on a HuggingFace pretrained config object
fix_lora_mapping: fix the auto mapping dictionary for a PEFT LoRA model
load_processor: load an AutoProcessor from a model directory even when config.json is missing
